subject: general
question: Rita performs ‘Giddha’ dance form. Which state does this dance form belong to?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Giddha’ dance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The popular folk dance **Gidda **is performed in Punjab
 
• The dance is **similar to Bhangra but performed only by women.**
 
• **The dance is especially famous in the village of Malwa.**
 
• Viyahula Giddha is danced in a circle. The girls form a ring. One of them uses a (dholki) while sitting in the centre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
